title: Additionality and Asymmetric Information in Environmental Markets: Evidence from Conservation Auctions
abstract: Mechanisms that aim to reduce environmental degradation at low cost can be undermined when participants' conservation actions are not marginal to the incentive—or “additional”—as the lowest-cost participants may not be the highest social value. We investigate this challenge in the Conservation Reserve Program's auction mechanism for ecosystem services, linking bids to satellite-derived land use. Three-quarters of marginal auction winners are not additional. The heterogeneity in counterfactual land use introduces adverse selection. We develop a model of bidding and additionality to quantify welfare implications. Alternative auctions increase efficiency by using scoring rules that incorporate expected land use impacts. (JEL D44, D82, Q24, Q57, R14)
abstract_zh: 当参与者的保护行为对激励机制而言并非“边际性”或“额外性”的时候，旨在以低成本减少环境退化的机制可能会失效，因为成本最低的参与者未必具有最高的社会价值。我们以保护储备计划（CRP）针对生态系统服务的拍卖机制为研究对象，将投标与卫星遥感得出的土地利用情况相关联，对这一挑战展开研究。边际拍卖中标者中，有四分之三并不具有额外性。反事实土地利用的异质性引发了逆向选择。我们构建了一个关于投标与额外性的模型，以量化其福利含义。替代性拍卖通过采用纳入预期土地利用影响的评分规则，提高了效率。（JEL D44, D82, Q24, Q57, R14）

title: The Shape of Regulation: 40 Years of Florida Flood Maps
abstract: Many regulations are geographically targeted. We study the evolution of the spatial targeting of floodplain regulation over four decades of regulatory map updates in Florida. We focus on changes in shape irregularity of regulated areas, measured using differences between regulated polygons and their convex hulls. While the regularity of mapped polygons is uncorrelated with development in initial maps, we observe decreases in regularity over time concentrated in highly developed geographies. These changes are uncorrelated with changes in risk due to adaptation. Our results highlight the possibility of endogenous regulation and the value of leveraging historical maps for empirical analysis.
abstract_zh: 许多监管措施具有地理针对性。我们利用佛罗里达州四十年间监管地图的更新数据，研究洪泛区监管的空间针对性演变。我们关注受监管区域形状不规则程度的变化，并以受监管多边形与其凸包之间的差异来衡量。尽管最初地图中多边形的规则性与开发活动无关，但我们观察到，随着时间推移，规则性下降，且集中出现在开发程度较高的地区。这些变化与因适应而产生的风险变化无关。我们的结果凸显了监管内生化的可能性，以及利用历史地图进行实证分析的价值。
